owner_directive: Finish ClayCode as an executable release before LoRA-1.
coordination_rule: Every claycode or harness worker reads this workspace and current live claims before taking a release task. Claims should be non-overlapping unless explicit replication/review is intended.

CC-WP-01-SPEC-FREEZE.goal: Fuse current candidates into one frozen executable semantic contract and model-facing representation.

CC-WP-02-PARSER-CANON.goal: Parser plus deterministic canonicalizer for frozen representation.

CC-WP-03-IR-TYPES.goal: Typed canonical IR, collection semantics, explicit epistemic states and semantic identity.

CC-WP-04-VALIDATOR.goal: Validator and type/effect checker with precise diagnostics.

CC-WP-05-EVALUATOR.goal: Reference evaluator/interpreter for executable core semantics.

CC-WP-06-EFFECT-IR.goal: General-purpose effect-intent semantics separated from authority and commit.

CC-WP-07-LOWERING.goal: Backend lowering interface and translation-validation contracts extending existing executable evidence.

CC-WP-10-HELDOUT.goal: Leak-resistant held-out generator and frozen evaluation suite.

CC-WP-11-HARNESS-INTEGRATION.goal: Use ClayCode runtime in real Harness turns; close integration bugs.

CC-WP-12-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Hashes, test execution manifest, open-limitations audit and PASS decision.
